about: Machine-readable benchmark of the 2026-10-12 persona test: 10 connections, one persona each, 32 questions scored against the ground-truth answers in docs/persona-test/ground-truth/.

persona.work: Marketing analyst, new in the job
persona.questions: Which countries outside the UK should we market to, which products sell best, and is there a busy season?

questions.question: Which countries outside the UK should we market to?
questions.truth_note: Top non-UK country is EIRE, clean gross 664,431.78 (naive net 615,519.55); then Netherlands 554,232.34, Germany 431,262.46. online_retail.md §4 Persona A, A1.

questions.question: Which products sell best?
questions.truth_note: Top product by clean revenue (non-product codes excluded) is 22423 REGENCY CAKESTAND 3 TIER 344,563.25; Manual/POSTAGE/DOTCOM POSTAGE are fee codes, not products. No number check because the persona may rank by units or revenue. online_retail.md §4 Persona B, B1.

questions.question: Is there a busy season?
questions.truth_note: Peak month 2011-11 at 1,509,496.33 (2010-11 1,470,272.48); Oct-Dec strongest. The November peak is seasonal, not growth: 2011 was -4.47% vs 2010 like-for-like. online_retail.md §4 Persona A, A3 and Persona C, C1; §2 Seasonality.

persona.work: I drive a yellow taxi in New York
persona.questions: Which hours of the day and which pickup areas earn me the most per trip, is airport work worth it, and how much do people usually tip?

questions.question: Which hours of the day earn me the most per trip?
questions.truth_note: Name check only: nyc_taxi.md §4 gives trip counts by hour (busiest 18:00) but no average total per trip by hour. FINDINGS_LOG.md S2 (Ask AI) records hour 5 as the highest average total per trip (raw 36.23, cleaned 37.60), with a low-volume caveat (about 18.7k trips).

questions.question: Which pickup areas earn me the most per trip?
questions.truth_note: Among pickup zones with >=1000 clean trips, highest average total is JFK Airport 80.89 (138,314 trips), then LaGuardia 66.37. Tiny-sample zones must not win. nyc_taxi.md §4 Persona 2, Q3.

questions.question: Is airport work worth it?
questions.truth_note: Airports earn the most per trip: JFK 80.89 and LaGuardia 66.37 average total (vs typical trip far lower; avg clean total 27.35). nyc_taxi.md §4 Persona 2, Q3 and §5 KPIs.

questions.question: How much do people usually tip?
questions.truth_note: Card trips only (cash tips are not recorded): avg tip 4.156, 22.62% of fare. Averaging all payments understates it (3.336 naive). nyc_taxi.md §4 Persona 2, Q1.

persona.work: Customer experience lead at an online marketplace
persona.questions: Do late deliveries cause bad reviews? How often are we late, and which states suffer most?

questions.question: Do late deliveries cause bad reviews?
questions.truth_note: Late orders average review 2.55 vs 4.28 on time: lateness lowers reviews. 4.14 is the wrong figure shown in the test. olist.md §4 Persona C, C2.

questions.question: How often are we late?
questions.truth_note: 8.11% of orders with a delivery date arrive late (7,827 of 96,476). olist.md §4 Persona B, B1.

questions.question: Which states suffer most?
questions.truth_note: Worst late rate among states with >=100 delivered orders: AL 23.93% (397 orders), then MA 19.67%. olist.md §4 Persona B, B2.

persona.questions: How many people work here now, which department pays most today, is there a gender pay gap, and in which years did most people leave?

questions.question: How many people work here now?
questions.truth_note: 240,124 current employees of 300,024 ever (59,900 left). employees.md §4 Persona A, A1.

questions.question: Which department pays most today?
questions.truth_note: Sales, current average salary 88,853 (then Marketing 80,059). Must be named, not shown as code d007. employees.md §4 Persona B, B2.

questions.question: Is there a gender pay gap?
questions.truth_note: Current average salary M 72,045 vs F 71,964: gap 81 (0.11%), effectively none. employees.md §4 Persona C, C1.

questions.question: In which years did most people leave?
questions.truth_note: Peak year of real leavers (last departure, transfers excluded) is 2000 with 7,610; 2001 7,241. employees.md §4 Persona A, A3.

persona.work: New operations supervisor at a delivery company
persona.questions: What share of our deliveries are late, which service type is the worst, and how many shipments are returned?

questions.question: What share of our deliveries are late?
questions.truth_note: 17.69% of delivered shipments were late (9,917 of 56,050, deduplicated). nile_express.md §4 Persona A, A1.

questions.question: Which service type is the worst?
questions.truth_note: Same Day is latest at 31.39% late (International 23.34%). nile_express.md §4 Persona A, A2.

questions.question: How many shipments are returned?
questions.truth_note: Returned 7,154 of 64,000 deduplicated shipments (11.18%). Not in §4; taken from nile_express.md §2 Status mix (and §5 KPIs return % 11.18%).

persona.work: I want to buy a used car for my family
persona.questions: What is a fair price for a 2015 to 2018 Toyota Corolla, how fast do prices drop with age, and in which governorate are used cars cheapest?

questions.question: What is a fair price for a 2015 to 2018 Toyota Corolla?
questions.truth_note: 29 used listings, median 850,000 EGP (mean 872,483; range 750,000-1,250,000). cars.md §4 Persona A, A1.

questions.question: How fast do prices drop with age?
questions.truth_note: Direction check only: medians by age are non-monotonic early (age 2 2,250,000; age 4 1,000,000) because of luxury mix, then fall steadily (age 10 640,000; age 15 450,000). No single per-year rate in the ground truth. cars.md §4 Persona A, A3.

questions.question: In which governorate are used cars cheapest?
questions.truth_note: Wrong-answer check only: cars.md §4 Persona B, B3 gives medians only for the three largest governorates (Cairo 745,000, Giza 650,000, Alexandria 590,000), not a full ranking, so no name can be required. Answers from 1-2 listings (Aswan, El Mansoura) are wrong. A read-only query suggests a smaller governorate (Beheira) is cheapest when only governorates with >=100 used listings count; add it to the ground truth before using it as a check.

persona.work: Small private investor in the stock market
persona.questions: Which companies had the most money traded, how much did COMI go up, and how did the whole market index do?

questions.question: Which companies had the most money traded (2023)?
questions.truth_note: Stocks only (index tickers excluded): COMI 74.55 bn EGP, BTFH 43.55 bn, HRHO 27.49 bn. Index tickers must not rank as companies. egx.md §4 Persona A, A1.

questions.question: How much did COMI go up in 2023?
questions.truth_note: COMI close 42.75 -> 76.89 = +79.9% (first to last 2023 close; data stops 2023-12-11). egx.md §4 Persona A, A2.

questions.question: How did the whole market index do in 2023?
questions.truth_note: EGX 30 +66.8% (last close 2022 14,598.53 -> last close 2023 24,351.12). A dataset limited to 2023 rows cannot reach the 2022 base exactly. egx.md §4 Persona B, B1.

persona.work: Journalist writing about the cost of living
persona.questions: How much have sugar and rice prices gone up since 2021, and how many refugees live in Egypt now compared with 2022?

questions.question: How much have sugar and rice prices gone up since 2021?
questions.truth_note: Average WFP price EGP/kg 2021 -> 2025: sugar 13.49 -> 41.90 (3.1x), rice 9.27 -> 29.22; the two commodities must not be averaged together. egypt_stats.md §4 Persona A, A3.

questions.question: How many refugees live in Egypt now compared with 2022?
questions.truth_note: All population groups (gender='all', age_range='all'): 2022 410,894 -> 2025 1,175,943 (+186%). Counting REF only (318,539 -> 243,580) reverses the story. egypt_stats.md §4 Persona B, B1 and B2.

persona.work: قائد وحدة يراجع تقارير تقييم الضباط
persona.questions: ما متوسط درجات التقييم، وأي سلاح أعلى، وما أضعف معيار، وهل تغيرت الدرجات عبر السنين؟

questions.question: ما متوسط درجات التقييم؟
questions.truth_note: Overall mean of the 20 criterion scores is 4.251 (scale 3-7). The appraiser percentage percent_a (mean about 85) is a different measure, not checked here. ai_data.md §4 Persona B, B1 and §3.

questions.question: أي سلاح أعلى؟
questions.truth_note: Naval scores best (4.349, 29 officers); artillery lowest (4.176); spread only 0.17. Arabic spelling ق.بحرية is the corp_name value in ai_officer (ground truth gives the English label). ai_data.md §4 Persona B, B1.

questions.question: ما أضعف معيار؟

any_of: reliance on him for additional work

questions.truth_note: Weakest criterion s3_7 = 4.160 (sub-item 17, 'reliance on him for additional work'); next s3_8 4.165. Arabic name as stored in eval_rep_sub_item. ai_data.md §4 Persona B, B2.

questions.question: هل تغيرت الدرجات عبر السنين؟
questions.truth_note: Flat: mean item score 2022 4.253, 2023 4.253, 2024 4.244, 2025 4.255 (2021 has 2 rows only). No direction check because there is no real change; the answer must give the yearly levels. ai_data.md §4 Persona B, B3.

persona.work: Owner of a small shop that sells online and wholesale
persona.questions: Which sales channel brings more money, which is my best month, and which city buys the most?

questions.question: Which sales channel brings more money?
questions.truth_note: Online 2,789,665.32, narrowly ahead of Wholesale 2,741,479.78 (differences are small; Wholesale has the best order value 915.66). demo_sqlite.md §4 Persona A, A3.

questions.question: Which is my best month?
questions.truth_note: Best month 2025-10 at 964,178.03 (then 2025-01 955,644.66). demo_sqlite.md §4 Persona A, A2.

questions.question: Which city buys the most?
questions.truth_note: Singapore 481,462.25 (530 orders), then Vienna 463,970.29. demo_sqlite.md §4 Persona B, B1.
